map.维修（响应/完成/回访）时效 使用指南: Maintenance (Response / Completion / Follow-up) Timeliness User Guide
map.维修响应、完成与回访时效工具按输入参数分段统计各环节时长与闭环率，适合物业服务全: The Maintenance Response, Completion and Follow-up Timeliness tool computes the duration of each stage and the closure rate from the input parameters, which suits full-process timeliness control and satisfaction improvement in property services.
map.维修完成时效 = 报修到完成时长: Maintenance completion timeliness = the duration from fault report to completion
map.物业客服中心统计每单从报修到完成的时长与回访率: A property management service centre tracks the time from fault report to completion per ticket along with the follow-up rate
map.考核外包维保单位的时效达标率: Review the timeliness compliance rate of outsourced maintenance contractors
map.业主投诉响应慢时调出工单时间线自证: When an owner complains about slow response, pull up the ticket timeline to show the record
map.：报修 09:00、响应 10:30（1.5 h）、完成 14:00（5 h）、: Fault reported 09:00, response 10:30 (1.5 h), completion 14:00 (5 h), follow-up the next day at 11:00 → response met the target (≤2 h), completion met the target (≤8 h), and the follow-up was done.
map.：本月 300 单，响应达标 285（95%）、完成达标 270（90%）、回访: This month 300 orders, response compliance 285 (95%), completion compliance 270 (90%), follow-up rate 88% → the misses cluster in night-time fault reports, so a night shift is needed.
map.响应和完成时长怎么界定？: How are the response and completion durations defined?
map.响应 = 接单到派人到场，完成 = 到场到修复；两者阈值不同（如响应 2 h、完: Response means from taking the ticket to arriving on site, completion means from arrival to the fix. The thresholds differ (for example 2 h for response and 8 h for completion).
map.回访率低有什么影响？: What does a low follow-up rate affect?
map.回访是闭环与满意度抓手，低于 85% 通常说明工单系统未强制闭环。: Follow-up is the handle on closure and satisfaction; below 85% it usually means the ticketing system is not forcing closure.
